<!-- START RESONATE -->
<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Keep acquisition source through the visit.
  //
  // GA4 gives consent-denied visitors a new random ID on every page load, so
  // each page they open after the first is reported as a separate "Direct"
  // session. This script carries the visit's acquisition source forward as
  // UTM parameters on internal links, so those pages are attributed to the
  // channel the visitor really came from.
  //
  // Nothing is written to cookies or storage. Only utm_* parameters are
  // carried, never click IDs or email tracking parameters. UTM values must
  // stay campaign-level (no contact IDs or email hashes), otherwise carrying
  // them would re-link the pages of a visitor who declined tracking.
  // Links are decorated at click time, so the HTML that crawlers see stays
  // clean.
  //
  // China edition: also recognises visits that arrive from WeChat, WeCom,
  // DingTalk, Feishu, QQ and Weibo. Those apps open links in their own
  // browser and send no referrer, so GA4 would otherwise file the whole visit
  // as "Direct". Recognition uses the share parameters WeChat appends to
  // links and the app's own browser name, never anything about the person.
  // Chinese search engines (Baidu, Sogou, 360, Shenma) are named the way GA4
  // names them.
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  // ---- Settings -------------------------------------------------------------

  // Links pointing at these domains (and their subdomains) are decorated.
  var SITE_DOMAINS = ['geekplus.com'];

  // Parameters carried from page to page: every parameter with this prefix.
  // Click IDs (gclid, fbclid, msclkid) and _hsenc / _hsmi are never carried.
  var CARRY_PREFIX = 'utm_';

  // A link that already has one of the carried parameters was tagged on
  // purpose. Leave it alone.
  var OVERWRITE_TAGGED_LINKS = false;

  // GA4 labels referrer-derived campaigns "(organic)" / "(referral)". Mirroring
  // that keeps the carried pages grouped with the landing page in reports.
  var MIRROR_GA4_CAMPAIGN_LABELS = true;

  // Referrer hosts translated to GA4's own source names (medium: organic).
  var SEARCH_ENGINES = {
    google:     /(^|\.)google\./,
    bing:       /(^|\.)bing\.com$/,
    yahoo:      /(^|\.)yahoo\./,
    duckduckgo: /(^|\.)duckduckgo\.com$/,
    baidu:      /(^|\.)baidu\.com$/,
    sogou:      /(^|\.)sogou\.com$/,
    so:         /(^|\.)so\.com$/,
    shenma:     /(^|\.)sm\.cn$/,
    yandex:     /(^|\.)yandex\./,
    naver:      /(^|\.)naver\.com$/,
    daum:       /(^|\.)daum\.net$/,
    ecosia:     /(^|\.)ecosia\.org$/
  };

  // Ad click IDs on the landing URL. Only the channel they imply is carried,
  // never the ID itself.
  var PAID_CLICK_IDS = { gclid: 'google', gbraid: 'google', wbraid: 'google', msclkid: 'bing' };

  // WeChat appends these to links shared inside the app. The value says where
  // the link was tapped: a chat, a group chat, or Moments (timeline).
  var WECHAT_SHARE_PARAM = 'from';
  var WECHAT_SHARE_VALUES = { singlemessage: 'chat', groupmessage: 'group', timeline: 'moments' };

  // In-app browsers that send no referrer, recognised by the app's own browser
  // name. Checked in order; the first match wins. WeCom's browser also carries
  // the WeChat name, so it is listed first.
  var IN_APP_BROWSERS = [
    { source: 'wecom',    test: /wxwork/i },
    { source: 'wechat',   test: /MicroMessenger/i },
    { source: 'dingtalk', test: /DingTalk/i },
    { source: 'feishu',   test: /Lark|Feishu/i },
    { source: 'qq',       test: /\bQQ\//i },
    { source: 'weibo',    test: /Weibo/i }
  ];

  // Medium used for the in-app sources above. "social" puts them in GA4's
  // Organic Social channel.
  var IN_APP_MEDIUM = 'social';

  // Add data-keep-utm-off to a link to exclude it.
  var OPT_OUT_ATTR = 'data-keep-utm-off';

  // ---- Helpers --------------------------------------------------------------

  function isSiteHost(hostname) {
    hostname = (hostname || '').toLowerCase();
    return SITE_DOMAINS.some(function (d) {
      return hostname === d || hostname.slice(-(d.length + 1)) === '.' + d;
    });
  }

  function hostOf(url) {
    try { return new URL(url, document.baseURI).hostname.toLowerCase(); }
    catch (e) { return ''; }
  }

  function isCarried(key) {
    return key.slice(0, CARRY_PREFIX.length) === CARRY_PREFIX;
  }

  function hasCarriedParam(searchParams) {
    var found = false;
    searchParams.forEach(function (value, key) { if (isCarried(key)) found = true; });
    return found;
  }

  // Work out how this visit started, from what the current page can see.
  // Returns {utm_source, utm_medium[, utm_campaign, ...]} or null (direct / unknown).
  function detectAcquisition(search, referrer, ownHostname, userAgent) {
    var params = new URLSearchParams(search || '');

    // 1) utm_* already on this page (a tagged landing, or a page we tagged).
    //    If they include utm_source the visit is fully described; carry as is.
    var carried = {};
    params.forEach(function (value, key) {
      if (isCarried(key) && value) carried[key] = value;
    });
    if (carried.utm_source) return carried;

    // 2) Otherwise work out source / medium, most specific signal first, and
    //    keep any other utm_* the page had on top.
    var derived = deriveFromClickId(params)
      || deriveFromWeChatShare(params)
      || deriveFromReferrer(referrer, ownHostname)
      || deriveFromInAppBrowser(userAgent);
    if (!derived) return Object.keys(carried).length ? carried : null;
    Object.keys(carried).forEach(function (k) { derived[k] = carried[k]; });
    return derived;
  }

  function deriveFromClickId(params) {
    for (var id in PAID_CLICK_IDS) {
      if (params.get(id)) return { utm_source: PAID_CLICK_IDS[id], utm_medium: 'cpc' };
    }
    return null;
  }

  // Link shared inside WeChat: the "from" value tells where it was tapped.
  function deriveFromWeChatShare(params) {
    var from = (params.get(WECHAT_SHARE_PARAM) || '').toLowerCase();
    if (!WECHAT_SHARE_VALUES[from]) return null;
    return { utm_source: 'wechat', utm_medium: IN_APP_MEDIUM, utm_campaign: '(' + WECHAT_SHARE_VALUES[from] + ')' };
  }

  // External referrer, named the way GA4 would name it.
  function deriveFromReferrer(referrer, ownHostname) {
    var refHost = hostOf(referrer);
    if (!refHost || refHost === (ownHostname || '').toLowerCase() || isSiteHost(refHost)) return null;

    for (var name in SEARCH_ENGINES) {
      if (SEARCH_ENGINES[name].test(refHost)) {
        return withCampaign({ utm_source: name, utm_medium: 'organic' }, '(organic)');
      }
    }
    return withCampaign({ utm_source: refHost.replace(/^www\./, ''), utm_medium: 'referral' }, '(referral)');
  }

  // No usable referrer: an in-app browser that never sends one.
  function deriveFromInAppBrowser(userAgent) {
    var ua = userAgent || '';
    for (var i = 0; i < IN_APP_BROWSERS.length; i++) {
      if (IN_APP_BROWSERS[i].test.test(ua)) {
        return { utm_source: IN_APP_BROWSERS[i].source, utm_medium: IN_APP_MEDIUM, utm_campaign: '(in-app)' };
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  function withCampaign(tags, label) {
    if (MIRROR_GA4_CAMPAIGN_LABELS) tags.utm_campaign = label;
    return tags;
  }

  // Return the href with the tags added, or the original href if it should be
  // left untouched.
  function decorate(href, tags) {
    if (!href || !tags) return href;
    var raw = href.trim();
    if (!raw || raw.charAt(0) === '#') return href;
    if (/^(mailto:|tel:|sms:|javascript:|data:|blob:)/i.test(raw)) return href;

    var url;
    try { url = new URL(raw, document.baseURI); }
    catch (e) { return href; }

    if (url.protocol !== 'http:' && url.protocol !== 'https:') return href;
    if (!isSiteHost(url.hostname)) return href;

    if (hasCarriedParam(url.searchParams) && !OVERWRITE_TAGGED_LINKS) return href;

    Object.keys(tags).forEach(function (k) { url.searchParams.set(k, tags[k]); });

    var isAbsolute = /^[a-z][a-z\d+\-.]*:/i.test(raw) || raw.indexOf('//') === 0;
    return isAbsolute ? url.href : url.pathname + url.search + url.hash;
  }

  // ---- Wiring ---------------------------------------------------------------

  var TAGS = detectAcquisition(window.location.search, document.referrer, window.location.hostname, navigator.userAgent);

  // Exposed for checking in the console: keepUtm.tags, keepUtm.decorate(href).
  window.keepUtm = {
    tags: TAGS,
    decorate: function (href) { return decorate(href, TAGS); }
  };

  if (!TAGS) return;

  function onInteraction(event) {
    var target = event.target;
    var a = target && target.closest ? target.closest('a[href]') : null;
    if (!a || a.hasAttribute(OPT_OUT_ATTR)) return;
    var href = a.getAttribute('href');
    var next = decorate(href, TAGS);
    if (next !== href) a.setAttribute('href', next);
  }

  // Capture phase, so the href is updated before the browser or any other
  // handler acts on it. click = left click, Enter, tap; auxclick = middle
  // click; contextmenu = right click ("open in new tab", "copy link").
  ['click', 'auxclick', 'contextmenu'].forEach(function (type) {
    document.addEventListener(type, onInteraction, true);
  });
})();
</script>
<!-- END RESONATE -->

<script>

  $(document).ready(function () {
    $(document).on('submit', '.top_menu_form_inner .marketingForm', function () {
      console.log('form----test');
      localStorage.setItem('marketingFormSubmitted', 'true');
      setTimeout(function () {
        window.location.href = "https://h5.meikehd.com/web/202510/Geek/ZHEN/v10/index.html";
      }, 100);
    });
    $('.top_menu_close').show();
  });

  $(document).ready(function(){

    // Render the 3D-Experience pop-up form only when it is opened. The placeholder div
    // carries the form details as data-fl-* attributes so the loader does not render it
    // (and register a form visit) on every page load. Renders once, then reuses it.
    function mountExperienceForm(attempt){
      var mount = document.getElementById('experience_form_mount');
      if (!mount || mount.getAttribute('data-mounted') === 'true') return;
      if (!(window.d365mktforms && window.d365mktforms.createForm)) {
        if ((attempt || 0) < 20) { setTimeout(function(){ mountExperienceForm((attempt || 0) + 1); }, 150); }
        return;
      }
      try {
        var z = window.d365mktforms.createForm(
          mount.getAttribute('data-fl-form-id'),
          mount.getAttribute('data-fl-api-url'),
          mount.getAttribute('data-fl-cached-url')
        );
        if (z) { mount.appendChild(z); mount.setAttribute('data-mounted', 'true'); }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    if (localStorage.getItem('marketingFormSubmitted') === 'true') {
      console.log("Hi ther");
      $('.top-header .menu .menu__wrapper li .menu__link[href="#experience"], .black-btn [href="#experience"], .item-list  [href="#experience"], .content-wrapper ul li [href="#experience"], .btndiv [href="#experience"]').attr("href","https://portal.geekplus.com/static/product-marketing/")
    }    
    $('.top-header .menu .menu__wrapper li .menu__link[href="#experience"], .black-btn [href="#experience"], .item-list  [href="#experience"], .content-wrapper ul li [href="#experience"], .btndiv [href="#experience"]').click(function (e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (localStorage.getItem('marketingFormSubmitted') === 'true') {

        window.location.href = "https://h5.meikehd.com/web/202510/Geek/ZHEN/v10/index.html";
        return false;
      }
      mountExperienceForm();
      $('body').addClass('experience_popup');
    });
    $('.top_menu_close').click(function () {
      $('body').removeClass('experience_popup');
    });


    $('.menu--mobile .menu__link[href="#experience"]').click(function (e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (localStorage.getItem('marketingFormSubmitted') === 'true') {

        window.location.href = "https://h5.meikehd.com/web/202510/Geek/ZHEN/v10/index.html";
        return false;
      }
      mountExperienceForm();
      $('body').addClass('experience_popup');
    });


  })

</script></div>
      </div>

            <div class="contentarea">
              
              <h2 class="heading">Shelf-to-Person (PopPick)</h2>
              
              
              <div class="content-rte">
                <h4><span>Flexible Solution. Faster Operations. Higher Throughput</span></h4>
<p><span>Bring shelves directly to your operators for lightning-fast picking. Ideal for small to mid-sized warehouses with a wide range of SKUs. </span></p>
              </div>
              
              
              <div class="btndiv">
                
                
                <a class="sol-btn" href="https://blog.geekplus.com/company/download/poppick_flyer?hsLang=en">

<div class="home-page-success  module_1760596802106  home_success_story" data-module="192012504635" id="success_story_sm">
  <div class="content-wrapper">
    <div class="inner-content">
      
      <div class="rte">
        <div id="hs_cos_wrapper_module_1760596802106_" class="hs_cos_wrapper hs_cos_wrapper_widget hs_cos_wrapper_type_inline_rich_text" style="" data-hs-cos-general-type="widget" data-hs-cos-type="inline_rich_text" data-hs-cos-field="header_content"><h2 style="text-align: center;"><span>Success Stories</span></h2>
<div style="text-align: center;">See how Geekplus solutions transform businesses and deliver exceptional results</div></div>
      </div>
      

      <div class="cstm-succ-tabs">
        <div class="tab ">
          
          
          <button class="tablinksmodule_1760596802106" id="defaultOpen">3PL</button>
          
          
          
          <button class="tablinksmodule_1760596802106" id="defaultOpen">Retail</button>

          <button class="tablinksmodule_1760596802106" id="defaultOpen">Apparel</button>
          
          
          
          <button class="tablinksmodule_1760596802106" id="defaultOpen">Manufacturing</button>

        <div id="tagmodule_1760596802106-1" class="tabcontentsec module_1760596802106">
          <div class="inner">
            <div class="flex-content">
              <div class="rte-content">
                <div id="hs_cos_wrapper_module_1760596802106_" class="hs_cos_wrapper hs_cos_wrapper_widget hs_cos_wrapper_type_inline_rich_text" style="" data-hs-cos-general-type="widget" data-hs-cos-type="inline_rich_text" data-hs-cos-field="content"><h4><span>UPS Warehouse Integrated Automation</span></h4>
<h5><span>The Challenge:</span></h5>
<p>UPS faced the need to optimize their 2&nbsp;million sq. ft. facility.&nbsp;</p>
<h5><span>Our Solution:</span></h5>
<p>Geekplus automated UPS's fulfillment center with 24/7 integrated robotic arms, Shelf-to-Person systems for peak efficiency.</p>
<h5><span>Results:</span></h5>
<ul>
<li data-start="131" data-end="178">Relocated 1,018 racks in under four hours</li>
<li data-start="131" data-end="178">Minimized system downtime during transition</li>
<li data-start="131" data-end="178">Maintained full operational continuity</li>
<li data-start="131" data-end="178">Improved warehouse layout efficiency post-move</li>
</ul></div>


                
                <div class="btn-testimonials">

        <div id="tagmodule_1760596802106-4" class="tabcontentsec module_1760596802106">

            <div class="flex-content">
              <div class="rte-content">
                <div id="hs_cos_wrapper_module_1760596802106_" class="hs_cos_wrapper hs_cos_wrapper_widget hs_cos_wrapper_type_inline_rich_text" style="" data-hs-cos-general-type="widget" data-hs-cos-type="inline_rich_text" data-hs-cos-field="content"><h4><span>Walmart: Scaling Retail Fulfillment with Robotic Picking&nbsp;</span></h4>
<h5>The Challenge:</h5>
<p>Walmart manages massive daily volumes and high SKU complexity.&nbsp;Manual picking caused high labor costs, high error rates, and heavy physical strain. Storage depth and demand volatility added more pressure.</p>
<h5>Our Solution:</h5>
<p>For the first time, Walmart adopted warehouse robotics. Geek+ launched a pilot in the Shenzhen Distribution Center, integrating the Geek+ Picking System with Walmart’s existing workflows.<br data-start="912" data-end="915"><br></p>
<h5>Results:</h5>
<ul>
<li data-start="1062" data-end="1125">
<p data-start="1064" data-end="1125">Walmart’s first robotic warehouse pilot—<strong data-start="1104" data-end="1123">a major success</strong></p>
</li>
<li data-start="1062" data-end="1125">
<p data-start="1064" data-end="1125">Picking productivity jumped from <strong data-start="1161" data-end="1194">149 to 533 pieces/person/hour</strong></p>
</li>
<li data-start="1197" data-end="1243">
<p data-start="1199" data-end="1243"><strong data-start="1199" data-end="1219">3.5× improvement</strong> in picking efficiency</p>
</li>
<li data-start="1244" data-end="1289">
<p data-start="1246" data-end="1289">Higher accuracy and lower labor intensity</p>
</li>
<li data-start="1290" data-end="1380">
<p data-start="1292" data-end="1380">Expansion underway: <strong data-start="1312" data-end="1330">18 more robots</strong> added and rollout extended to <strong data-start="1361" data-end="1378">Walmart Chile</strong></p>
</li>
</ul></div>

                <div id="hs_cos_wrapper_module_1760596802106_" class="hs_cos_wrapper hs_cos_wrapper_widget hs_cos_wrapper_type_inline_rich_text" style="" data-hs-cos-general-type="widget" data-hs-cos-type="inline_rich_text" data-hs-cos-field="content"><h4>S&amp;S Activewear – Integrated Apparel Fulfillment Automation</h4>
<h5><span>The Challenge:</span></h5>
<p data-start="478" data-end="677">S&amp;S Activewear needed to optimize and scale fulfillment across their large, high-volume apparel distribution network. As order volumes grew, the team faced:</p>
<ul data-start="679" data-end="954">
<li data-start="679" data-end="740">
<p data-start="681" data-end="740">Inefficient labor allocation across fast-moving inventory</p>
</li>
<li data-start="741" data-end="790">
<p data-start="743" data-end="790">Increasing demand for higher picking accuracy</p>
</li>
<li data-start="791" data-end="842">
<p data-start="793" data-end="842">Manual workflows slowing down fulfillment speed</p>
</li>
<li data-start="843" data-end="887">
<p data-start="845" data-end="887">Growing SKU complexity and order variety</p>
</li>
<li data-start="888" data-end="954">
<p data-start="890" data-end="954">Rising customer expectations for rapid and error-free delivery</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h5><span>Our Solution:</span></h5>
<p>Geekplus deployed an end-to-end PopPick Goods-to-Person system across S&amp;S Activewear’s operation, combining fast robotic picking, automated tote handling, and real-time warehouse optimization.</p></div>

                <div id="hs_cos_wrapper_module_1760596802106_" class="hs_cos_wrapper hs_cos_wrapper_widget hs_cos_wrapper_type_inline_rich_text" style="" data-hs-cos-general-type="widget" data-hs-cos-type="inline_rich_text" data-hs-cos-field="content"><h4>Siemens: Warehouse Integrated Automation</h4>
<h5><span>The Challenge:</span></h5>
<p>Siemens needed to improve its busy warehouse. The team wanted higher storage space, faster material movement, and an automation system that could work without stopping production.</p>
<h5><span>Our Solution:</span></h5>
<p>Geekplus installed a full warehouse automation system using AMRs, smart storage, and real-time software links to WMS/MES. Shelf-to-Person and Goods-to-Production workflows supported 24/7 operations with very little disruption.</p>
<h5><span>Results:</span></h5>
<ul style="line-height: 1;">
<li data-start="577" data-end="623">
<p data-start="579" data-end="623">Moved hundreds of racks within a few hours</p>
</li>
<li data-start="624" data-end="674">
<p data-start="626" data-end="674">Kept downtime almost at zero during the change</p>
</li>
<li data-start="675" data-end="730">
<p data-start="677" data-end="730">Production and material supply stayed fully running</p>
</li>
<li data-start="731" data-end="788">
<p data-start="733" data-end="788">Storage space increased and warehouse layout improved</p>
</li>
</ul></div>

                <div id="hs_cos_wrapper_widget_1767156157282_" class="hs_cos_wrapper hs_cos_wrapper_widget hs_cos_wrapper_type_inline_rich_text" style="" data-hs-cos-general-type="widget" data-hs-cos-type="inline_rich_text" data-hs-cos-field="content"><p><span>Case Study</span></p>
<h4><span><strong>Newegg: Boosting Fulfillment Speed with Geek+ Robotics</strong> </span></h4>
<p class="always-visible"><strong>The Challenge: </strong>Newegg needed to handle rising order volumes. Manual picking was slow, required long walking distances, and limited throughput and accuracy.</p>
<br>
<div class="more-content">
<p><strong>Our Solution: </strong>Geek+ installed a Shelf-to-Person system with P800 robots. The robots lifted shelves and brought them directly to pickers. Smart software optimized routes and organized 24,360 storage locations for faster access.</p>
<p><strong>Results:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Faster picking and shipping</li>
<li>Higher accuracy and safer workflows</li>
<li>Better use of warehouse space</li>
<li>Less physical strain for workers</li>
<li>Full deployment completed in six weeks</li>
</ul>
</div>

<h4><span><strong>Walmart: Scaling Retail Fulfillment with Robotic Picking</strong> </span></h4>
<p class="always-visible"><strong>The Challenge: </strong>Walmart manages massive daily volumes and high SKU complexity. Manual picking caused high labor costs, high error rates, and heavy physical strain. Storage depth and demand volatility added more pressure.</p>
<br>
<div class="more-content">
<p><strong>Our Solution: </strong>For the first time, Walmart adopted warehouse robotics. Geek+ launched a pilot in the Shenzhen Distribution Center, integrating the Geek+ Picking System with Walmart’s existing workflows.</p>
<p><strong>Results:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Walmart’s first robotic warehouse pilot—<strong>a major success</strong></li>
<li>Picking productivity jumped from <strong>149 to 533 pieces/person/hour</strong></li>
<li><strong>3.5× improvement</strong> in picking efficiency</li>
<li>Higher accuracy and lower labor intensitye</li>
<li>Expansion underway: <strong>18 more robots</strong> added and rollout extended to <strong>Walmart Chile</strong></li>
</ul>

              <div class="rte-content">
                <div id="hs_cos_wrapper_widget_1767156157282_" class="hs_cos_wrapper hs_cos_wrapper_widget hs_cos_wrapper_type_inline_rich_text" style="" data-hs-cos-general-type="widget" data-hs-cos-type="inline_rich_text" data-hs-cos-field="content"><p><span>Case Study</span></p>
<h4><span><strong>Siemens: Warehouse Integrated Automation </strong> </span></h4>
<p class="always-visible"><strong>The Challenge: </strong>Siemens needed to improve its busy warehouse. The team wanted higher storage space, faster material movement, and an automation system that could work without stopping production.</p>
<br>
<div class="more-content">
<p><strong>Our Solution: </strong>Geekplus installed a full warehouse automation system using AMRs, smart storage, and real-time software links to WMS/MES. Shelf-to-Person and Goods-to-Production workflows supported 24/7 operations with very little disruption.</p>
<p><strong>Results:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Moved hundreds of racks within a few hours</li>
<li>Kept downtime almost at zero during the change</li>
<li>Production and material supply stayed fully runningy</li>
<li>Storage space increased and warehouse layout improved</li>
</ul>
</div>
<p class="toggle-btn">Read More</p>
<ul class="inline_tag">
<li>3PL</li>
<li>Shelf-to-Person</li>
<li>P800</li>
<li>EMEA</li>
</ul></div>

<div id="hs_cos_wrapper_module_17605965417092" class="hs_cos_wrapper hs_cos_wrapper_widget hs_cos_wrapper_type_module" style="" data-hs-cos-general-type="widget" data-hs-cos-type="module"><div class="geek-faq-section homepage-faq" id="home_faq_sm">
  <div class="content-wrapper">
    <div class="faq-container">
      <div class="header-text">
        <h2>FAQs</h2>
      </div>
      <div class="faq-repeater">
        
        <div class="faq-item ">
          <div class="faq-question">
            What industries benefit the most from Geekplus solutions?
            <span class="faq-toggle">+</span>
          </div>
          <div class="faq-answer">
            <p><span>Geekplus caters to a wide range of industries, including eCommerce, 3PL, apparel, healthcare, groceries, auto manufacturing, and temperature-controlled storage. It helps businesses streamline operations, reduce costs, and boost efficiency with tailored automation solutions.</span></p>
          </div>
        </div>
        
        <div class="faq-item ">
          <div class="faq-question">
            Can Geekplus automations done with in a traditional warehouse?
            <span class="faq-toggle">+</span>
          </div>
          <div class="faq-answer">
            <p>Yes, Geekplus automation can be integrated into traditional warehouses with minimal adjustments.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        
        <div class="faq-item ">
          <div class="faq-question">
            How does Geekplus improve warehouse productivity?
            <span class="faq-toggle">+</span>
          </div>
          <div class="faq-answer">
            <p><span>With advanced robotics like the P1200 and RS Air, Geekplus boosts picking efficiency by up to 200%. Features like dynamic slotting, seamless human-robot collaboration, and real-time task management ensure faster, error-free operations across inbound, outbound, and storage processes.</span></p>
          </div>
        </div>
        
        <div class="faq-item ">
          <div class="faq-question">
            Why should I choose Geekplus over other automation providers?
            <span class="faq-toggle">+</span>
          </div>
          <div class="faq-answer">
            <p><span>Geekplus combines cutting-edge robotics with intelligent software to offer industry-specific solutions. With faster deployment, high ROI, and unmatched operational insights, it’s the preferred automation partner for businesses worldwide looking to stay competitive in a rapidly evolving market.</span></p>
          </div>
        </div>
        
        <div class="faq-item ">
          <div class="faq-question">
            Who handles installation and go-live?
            <span class="faq-toggle">+</span>
          </div>
          <div class="faq-answer">
            <p>Our implementation team works with certified local partners to handle installation, testing, and training. You'll have a dedicated Geekplus project manager supporting you from planning to go-live.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        
        <div class="faq-item ">
          <div class="faq-question">
            Will my operations need to stop during implementation?
            <span class="faq-toggle">+</span>
          </div>
          <div class="faq-answer">
            <p>No. Most of our customers continue running during setup. We design the project to minimize disruption and, where needed, phase the rollout by zones or shifts.</p>
          </div>
        </div>

    <script>
      let originalParent = null;
      let originalNextSibling = null;
      let isWrapped = false; // Track if the sections are wrapped

      function moveSectionOnResize() {
        const sectionToMove = document.querySelector('.cell_17382233689202-vertical-alignment');
        const targetSection = document.querySelector('.cell_1738223725574-vertical-alignment');

        if (window.outerWidth <= 1024) {
          if (sectionToMove && targetSection) {
            // If the sections are not wrapped yet, wrap them
            if (!isWrapped) {
              if (!originalParent) {
                originalParent = sectionToMove.parentNode;
                originalNextSibling = sectionToMove.nextSibling;
              }

              // Insert sectionToMove next to targetSection
              targetSection.parentNode.insertBefore(sectionToMove, targetSection.nextSibling);

              // Wrap sectionToMove and targetSection in a new div
              const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
              wrapper.classList.add('wrapped'); // Optional: Add class for styling if needed
              sectionToMove.parentNode.insertBefore(wrapper, sectionToMove);
              wrapper.appendChild(sectionToMove);
              wrapper.appendChild(targetSection);

              isWrapped = true; // Mark as wrapped
            }
          }
        } else {
          if (sectionToMove && originalParent && isWrapped) {
            // If wrapped, unwrap the sections and restore the original layout
            const wrapper = sectionToMove.parentNode;
            if (wrapper && wrapper.classList.contains('wrapped')) {
              // Move both sections out of the wrapper
              wrapper.parentNode.insertBefore(sectionToMove, wrapper);
              wrapper.parentNode.insertBefore(targetSection, sectionToMove.nextSibling);

              // Remove the wrapper div
              wrapper.remove();

              isWrapped = false; // Mark as unwrapped
            }

            // Restore original positions if necessary
            originalParent.insertBefore(sectionToMove, originalNextSibling || null);
          }
        }
      }

      window.addEventListener('load', moveSectionOnResize);
      window.addEventListener('resize', moveSectionOnResize);



      document.getElementById("mobile-toggle").addEventListener("click", function() {

    <script>
      window.addEventListener("scroll", function () {
        const scrollTrigger = 50; // scroll offset in px
        //const headerMain = document.querySelector(".header-main");
        const customTabMenu = document.querySelector(".custm-taba-menu");

        if (window.scrollY > scrollTrigger) {
          //headerMain.classList.add("active");
          $(customTabMenu).addClass('active');
          //customTabMenu.classList.add("active");
        } else {
          //headerMain.classList.remove("active");
          $(customTabMenu).removeClass('active');
          //customTabMenu.classList.remove("active");
        }
      });

      jQuery(function($) {
        $('#mobile-toggle').on('click', function() {
          $(this).toggleClass('active');
        });
      });

      //         jQuery(function($) {
      //   $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(e) {

      let lastScrollTop = 0;

      $(window).on('scroll', function () {
        const currentScroll = $(this).scrollTop();

        if (currentScroll > lastScrollTop && currentScroll > 50) {
          // Scroll Down — Hide elements
          $('.header-main, .custm-tab-menu, .main-ans-bar').addClass('hide');
        } else {
          // Scroll Up — Show elements
          $('.header-main, .custm-tab-menu, .main-ans-bar').removeClass('hide');
        }

        lastScrollTop = currentScroll;
      });


      let lastScrollTop1 = 0;
      $(window).on('scroll', function () {
        const currentScroll1 = $(this).scrollTop();
        if (currentScroll1 > lastScrollTop1 && currentScroll1 > 50) {
          // Scroll Down — Hide elements
          $('body').addClass('stickyg');
        } else {
          // Scroll Up — Show elements
          $('body').removeClass('stickyg');
        }
        lastScrollTop1 = currentScroll1;
      });



      $(document).ready(function () {
        if ($(window).width() >= 767) {
          const $stickyTitles = $('.stickytitle');
          const $sections = $('.content-wrapper');
          const $stickyContent = $('.sd-richtext.sol-rich.sticky-content');
          const $stickyContent2 = $('.sd-richtext.sol-rich.sticky-content22');
          const $stopSection = $('.sd-mainImgtext .geek-content-image.cstm--3');

          // This sticky-scroll feature only exists on pages that have the stop section.
          // Without it, offset() below is undefined and throws on every scroll — so skip it here.
          if (!$stopSection.length) return;

          $(window).on('scroll', function () {
            let windowHeight = $(window).height();
            let scrollTop = $(window).scrollTop();

            // ✅ Sticky title logic
            $sections.each(function () {
              const sectionTop = $(this).offset().top;
              const spanText = $(this).find('h2 span').text().trim();

              if (scrollTop + windowHeight / 2 >= sectionTop) {
                $stickyTitles.filter('[data-type="' + spanText + '"]').show();
              } else {
                $stickyTitles.filter('[data-type="' + spanText + '"]').hide();
              }
            });

            // ✅ Check if sticky content reached stop section
            const stopOffset = $stopSection.offset().top;
            const stickyHeight = $stickyContent.outerHeight();
            const stickyHeight2 = $stickyContent2.outerHeight();

            if (scrollTop + stickyHeight >= stopOffset) {
              // Remove fixed when reaching stop section
              $stickyContent.css({
                position: 'absolute',
                top: stopOffset - stickyHeight + 'px'
              });
              $stickyContent2.css({
                position: 'absolute',
                top: stopOffset - stickyHeight + 'px'
              });
            } else {
              // Keep it fixed otherwise
              $stickyContent.css({
                position: 'fixed',
                top: '113px'
              });
              $stickyContent2.css({
                position: 'fixed',
                top: '113px'
              });
            }

            if (scrollTop + stickyHeight2 >= stopOffset) { 
              $stickyContent2.css({
                position: 'absolute',
                top: stopOffset - stickyHeight + 'px'
              });
            } else { 
              $stickyContent2.css({
                position: 'fixed',
                top: '113px'
              });
            }


          });

          // Trigger once on page load
          $(window).trigger('scroll');
        }
      });



      $(document).ready(function () {
        // Run this only on mobile (767px or below)
        if ($(window).width() <= 767) {
          const $stickyTitles = $('.stickytitle');

          $(window).on('scroll', function () {
            let windowHeight = $(window).height();
            let scrollTop = $(window).scrollTop();

            $('.content-wrapper').each(function () {
              const sectionTop = $(this).offset().top;
              const sectionBottom = sectionTop + $(this).outerHeight();

              if (scrollTop + windowHeight / 2 >= sectionTop && scrollTop + windowHeight / 2 <= sectionBottom) {
                let spanText = $(this).find('h2 span').text().trim();
                $stickyTitles.hide();
                $stickyTitles.filter('[data-type="' + spanText + '"]').show();
              }
            });
          });

          // Trigger once on load
          $(window).trigger('scroll');
        }
      });

    </script>

      //  Get cookie by name
      function getCookie(name) {
        const value = `; ${document.cookie}`;
        const parts = value.split(`; ${name}=`);
        if (parts.length === 2) return parts.pop().split(';').shift();
        return null;
      }

      //  Detect source based on document.referrer
      function detectOriginalSource() {
        const ref = document.referrer;
        if (!ref) return 'Direct';
        if (ref.includes('google.') || ref.includes('bing.') || ref.includes('yahoo.')) return 'Organic Search';
        if (ref.includes('facebook.') || ref.includes('instagram.') || ref.includes('linkedin.') || ref.includes('twitter.')) return 'Social Media';
        return 'Referral';
      }

      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
        const hubspotutk = getCookie('hubspotutk');
        const pageUrl = window.location.href;
        const pageTitle = document.title;
        const referrer = document.referrer;
        const originalSource = detectOriginalSource();

        console.log(' HubSpot Tracking Data:');
        console.log(' Page URL:', pageUrl);
        console.log('🏷 Page Title:', pageTitle);
        console.log(' Referrer:', referrer || 'Direct');
        console.log(' Original Source:', originalSource);
        console.log(' HubSpot UTK:', hubspotutk || 'Not available');


      });
    </script>

<script>
  const toggle = document.getElementById('mode-toggle');
  const body = document.body;
  const modeText = document.getElementById('mode-text');


  body.classList.add('white-mode');
  toggle.checked = true;
  modeText.textContent = "Dark Mode"; // default text

  // Check for saved user preference, if any
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    const darkMode = localStorage.getItem('darkMode');

    if (darkMode === 'disabled') {
      body.classList.remove('white-mode');
      toggle.checked = false;
      modeText.textContent = "White Mode";
    }
  });

  toggle.addEventListener('change', function () {
    if (this.checked) {
      body.classList.add('white-mode');
      localStorage.setItem('darkMode', 'enabled');
      modeText.textContent = "Dark Mode";
    } else {
      body.classList.remove('white-mode');
      localStorage.setItem('darkMode', 'disabled');
      modeText.textContent = "Light Mode";
    }
  });
</script>

    $('.menu--desktop .menu__item--has-submenu').on('click', function (e) {
      e.stopPropagation(); // prevent body click from firing immediately
      const $current = $(this);
      const isOpen = $current.hasClass('menu__item--open');

      // Close all
      $('.menu--desktop .menu__item--has-submenu')
        .removeClass('menu__item--open')
        .find('a, button').attr('aria-expanded', 'false');

      // If it wasn't open before, open it now
      if (!isOpen) {
        $current.addClass('menu__item--open');
        $current.find('a, button').attr('aria-expanded', 'true');
      }
    });

    // Close dropdown when clicking outside
    $(document).on('click', function (e) {
      if (!$(e.target).closest('.menu--desktop .menu__item--has-submenu').length) {
        $('.menu--desktop .menu__item--has-submenu')
          .removeClass('menu__item--open')
          .find('a, button').attr('aria-expanded', 'false');
      }
    });


    if (menuParentItems) {
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(menuParentItems, function(el){

        // Menu item variables

        var childToggle = el.querySelector('.menu__child-toggle');

        // Handles hover over

        // Handles toggle of submenus

        childToggle.addEventListener('click', function(){
          if (this.parentNode.classList.contains('menu__item--open')) {
            this.parentNode.classList.remove('menu__item--open');
            this.parentNode.querySelector('a').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
            this.parentNode.querySelector('button').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
          }
          else {
            this.parentNode.classList.add('menu__item--open');
            this.parentNode.querySelector('a').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
            this.parentNode.querySelector('button').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
          }
        });

      });

    }

    // Mobile menu

    // Handles toggle of submenus

    if (childToggle) {
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(childToggle, function(el){

        el.addEventListener('click', function(){
          this.classList.toggle('menu__child-toggle--open');
          if (this.parentNode.classList.contains('menu__item--open')) {
            this.parentNode.classList.remove('menu__item--open');
            this.parentNode.querySelector('a').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
            this.parentNode.querySelector('button').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
          }
          else {
            this.parentNode.classList.add('menu__item--open');
            this.parentNode.querySelector('a').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
            this.parentNode.querySelector('button').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
          }
        });

      });
    }

<script>
  
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  const navLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.menu_list a[href^="#"]');

  // collect sections that exist on the page
  const sections = Array.from(navLinks)
    .map(link => {
      const target = document.querySelector(link.getAttribute('href'));
      return target ? target : null;
    })
    .filter(Boolean);

  if (sections.length === 0) return;

  // observer for active section detection
 const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      const id = entry.target.getAttribute("id");
      const navLink = document.querySelector(`.menu_list a[href="#${id}"]`);
      
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        // Remove active classes from all links and their parents
        navLinks.forEach(link => {
          link.classList.remove("active");
          if (link.parentElement) {
            link.parentElement.classList.remove("activeList");
          }
        });

        // Add active classes to current link and its parent
        if (navLink) {
          navLink.classList.add("active");
          if (navLink.parentElement) {
            navLink.parentElement.classList.add("activeList");
          }
        }
      }
    });
  }, {
    rootMargin: "-50% 0px -50% 0px", // triggers near middle
    threshold: 0
  });

  sections.forEach(section => observer.observe(section));
}); 




document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
const menuItems = document.querySelectorAll(".menu_list_inr");

menuItems.forEach(item => {
item.addEventListener("click", function() {
// Remove activeList from all
menuItems.forEach(li => li.classList.remove("activeList"));
// Add activeList to clicked one
this.classList.add("activeList");
});
});
});

const header = document.getElementsByClassName("side_menu_bar")[0];

if (currentScroll > lastScroll) {
// scroll down
header.classList.add("scrolled");
}  

lastScroll = currentScroll;
});

<script>
  var video = document.getElementById("shelf");
  if (video) {
  var spinner = document.getElementById("spinner");
  var delayMillis = 4000;
  var spinnerIsHere = 1;
  video.volume = 0;

  var playVid = setTimeout(function() {
    if(spinnerIsHere == 1) {
      // Delete element DOM
      // spinner.parentNode.removeChild(spinner);
      spinner.style.visibility = "hidden";
      spinnerIsHere = 0;
    }
    video.play();
  }, delayMillis);

  video.addEventListener("click", function( event ) {
    if(video.paused) {
      if(spinnerIsHere == 1) {
        // Delete element DOM
        // spinner.parentNode.removeChild(spinner);
        spinner.style.visibility = "hidden";
        spinnerIsHere = 0;
      }
      clearTimeout(playVid);
      video.play();
    } else {
      video.pause();
      if(spinnerIsHere == 0) {
        spinner.style.visibility = "visible";
        spinnerIsHere = 1;
      }
    }
  }, false);
  }
</script>

<script>
  function openCitys(evtmodule_17613043369836, cityNamemodule_17613043369836) {
    var imodule_17613043369836, tabcontentmodule_17613043369836, tablinksmodule_17613043369836;

    // Hide all tab contents
    tabcontentmodule_17613043369836 = document.getElementsByClassName("tabcontent module_17613043369836");
                                                         for (imodule_17613043369836 = 0; imodule_17613043369836 < tabcontentmodule_17613043369836.length; imodule_17613043369836++) {
      tabcontentmodule_17613043369836[imodule_17613043369836].style.display = "none";
    }

    // Remove 'active' class from all tab links
    tablinksmodule_17613043369836 = document.getElementsByClassName("tablinks module_17613043369836");
                                                       for (imodule_17613043369836 = 0; imodule_17613043369836 < tablinksmodule_17613043369836.length; imodule_17613043369836++) {
      tablinksmodule_17613043369836[imodule_17613043369836].className = tablinksmodule_17613043369836[imodule_17613043369836].className.replace(" active", "");
    }

    // Show current tab and add 'active' class
    document.getElementById(cityNamemodule_17613043369836).style.display = "block";
    evtmodule_17613043369836.currentTarget.className += " active";
  }

  // Wait for DOM to load
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const tabLinks = document.getElementsByClassName("tablinks module_17613043369836");
    const tabContents = document.getElementsByClassName("tabcontent module_17613043369836");

    // Activate a tab by index directly, without dispatching a DOM click.
    // Auto-rotation must not simulate a real click: a scripted .click() still
    // dispatches a click event that automatic button-click tracking records,
    // producing a stream of fake engagement events. Switching the tab directly
    // avoids that while genuine user clicks (below) are still tracked normally.
    function activateTab(index) {
        const tab = tabLinks[index];
        if (!tab) return;
        for (let i = 0; i < tabContents.length; i++) tabContents[i].style.display = "none";
        for (let i = 0; i < tabLinks.length; i++) tabLinks[i].className = tabLinks[i].className.replace(" active", "");
        const content = document.getElementById("tabmodule_17613043369836-" + (index + 1));
        if (content) content.style.display = "block";
        tab.className += " active";
    }

    // Default open first tab
    activateTab(0);

    // Auto rotate tabs
    let currentIndex = 0;
    let userClicked = false; // flag to detect user interaction

    // Start auto-rotation
    const intervalId = setInterval(function() {
        if (!userClicked) { // only rotate if user hasn't interacted
            currentIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % tabLinks.length;
            activateTab(currentIndex);
        }
    }, 5000); // 5 seconds interval

    // Stop auto-rotation on a genuine user click (the inline onclick handles activation)
    Array.from(tabLinks).forEach(function(tab) {
        tab.addEventListener("click", function() {
            userClicked = true;        // stop future rotations
            clearInterval(intervalId); // stop interval
        });
    });
});


</script>



<script>
  class LogosMarquee {
    constructor({
      containerSelector = ".marquee__ctn",
      trackSelector = ".marquee__track",
      speed = 60 // pixels per second
    } = {}) {
      this.container = document.querySelector(containerSelector);
      this.track = document.querySelector(trackSelector);
      this.speed = speed;

      if (!this.container || !this.track) {
        console.warn("Marquee: éléments introuvables.");
        return;
      }

      this.trackWidth = this.track.getBoundingClientRect().width;
      this.pos = 0;
      this.start = null;
      this.rafId = null;

      this.setup();
      this.animate = this.animate.bind(this); // Bind pour requestAnimationFrame
      requestAnimationFrame(this.animate);
    }

    setup() {
      // Étendre la largeur du container
      this.container.style.width = `${this.trackWidth}px`;

      // Dupliquer le contenu pour boucler visuellement
      this.clone = this.track.cloneNode(true);
      this.container.appendChild(this.clone);

      // Optimisation mobile
      this.container.style.willChange = "transform";
    }

    animate(timestamp) {
      if (!this.start) this.start = timestamp;

      const elapsed = timestamp - this.start;
      this.pos = -(elapsed / 1000) * this.speed;

      if (Math.abs(this.pos) >= this.trackWidth) {
        this.start = timestamp;
        this.pos = 0;
      }

      this.container.style.transform = `translateX(${this.pos}px)`;

      this.rafId = requestAnimationFrame(this.animate);
    }

    destroy() {
      cancelAnimationFrame(this.rafId);
      if (this.clone) this.clone.remove();
      this.container.style.transform = "";
      this.container.style.willChange = "";
    }
  }

  window.addEventListener("load", () => {
    const marquee = new LogosMarquee({
      containerSelector: ".marquee__ctn",
      trackSelector: ".marquee__track",
      speed: 80
    });

  });
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
    const counters = document.querySelectorAll('.stat-number');
    const animateCounter = (counter) => {
      const target = parseFloat(counter.getAttribute('data-target'));
      const suffix = counter.getAttribute('data-suffix') || '';
      const prefix = counter.getAttribute('data-prefix') || '';
      const unit = counter.getAttribute('data-unit') || '';
      const isDecimal = counter.getAttribute('data-decimal') === 'true';
      const useComma = counter.getAttribute('data-comma') === 'true';
      const steps = 60;
      let count = 0;
      const increment = target / steps;
      const formatValue = (val) => {
        let value = isDecimal ? val.toFixed(2).replace(/\.?0+$/, '') : Math.floor(val);
        if (useComma && !isDecimal) value = Number(value).toLocaleString();
        return prefix + value + unit + suffix;
      };
      const update = () => {
        count += increment;
        if (count < target) {
          counter.textContent = formatValue(count);
          requestAnimationFrame(update);
        } else {
          counter.textContent = formatValue(target);
        }
      };
      update();
    };
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries, obs) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          animateCounter(entry.target);
          obs.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, {
      threshold: 0.6
    });
    counters.forEach(counter => {
      observer.observe(counter);
    });
  });
</script>

<script>
  $(document).ready(function(){
    $(".faq-question").click(function(){
      var parent = $(this).parent();
      // Close all other answers
      $(".faq-item").not(parent).removeClass("active");
      $(".faq-item").not(parent).find(".faq-answer").slideUp();
      $(".faq-item").not(parent).find(".faq-toggle").text("+");
      // Toggle the clicked one
      parent.toggleClass("active");
      parent.find(".faq-answer").slideToggle();
      // Change + to × when active
      var toggleSign = parent.hasClass("active") ? "×" : "+";
      parent.find(".faq-toggle").text(toggleSign);
    });
  });
</script>
